Required Ports

This page lists all TCP and UDP ports used by Omnia services across the OIM and cluster nodes. Open these ports in firewalld or your network firewall before deploying.

Port

Protocol

Service

Description

67

UDP

CoreDHCP (server)

DHCP server for node provisioning. OIM listens for DHCP requests.

68

UDP

CoreDHCP (client)

DHCP client responses.

69

UDP

TFTP

Trivial File Transfer Protocol for PXE boot file delivery.

80

TCP

HTTP

HTTP service for provisioning images, kickstart files, and repository metadata.

443

TCP

HTTPS

Secure HTTP for Pulp API, AWX web interface, and repository access.

8443

TCP

OpenCHAMI API

RESTful API for node lifecycle management and inventory queries.

8444

TCP

Boot Script Service API for iPXE boot script generation.

5432

TCP

Database backend for Pulp and OpenCHAMI (local connections only).

6817

TCP

Slurm (srun)

Slurm srun command communication (if Slurm client on OIM).

Firewall rule summary

Note

When enable_firewall: true is set in security_config.yml, Omnia automatically configures firewalld rules for all required ports on each node based on its assigned role. Manual firewall configuration is only necessary when using external firewalls (e.g., network-level ACLs on switches).

Note

  • Security Config – Firewall and security settings.

  • Telemetry Config – Telemetry port configuration.

  • Minimum Nodes – Node counts per deployment scenario.
